crossRefs.note: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to Yahweh, and said, “I will sing to Yahweh, for he has triumphed…
He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
Yahweh reigns! He is clothed with majesty! Yahweh is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be…
Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
As often as the trumpet sounds he snorts, ‘Aha!’ He smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the…
James the son of Zebedee; and John, the brother of James, (whom he called Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder);

translations.web: “Have you given the horse might? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane?
translations.bsb: Do you give strength to the horse or adorn his neck with a mane?
translations.kjv: Hast thou given the horse strength? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder?
translations.asv: Hast thou given the horse his might? Hast thou clothed his neck with the quivering mane?
